profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, that trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. Its most recently reported annual revenue, for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, was $41,525,000,000, as filed in a 10-K. The company's products span customer relationship management, business intelligence, and workplace collaboration, with AI now embedded across all three areas.

Slack AI is Salesforce's embedded AI capability within the Slack messaging platform, described by the company's site as a productivity tool that summarizes channels and threads, delivers daily recaps, searches files, translates conversations, takes meeting notes, and automates workflows. A feature called Slackbot serves as a personal AI agent that the site says learns a user's tone and voice. The site states that customer data is not used to train the large language models powering these features, and that the LLMs are hosted within Slack's own AWS virtual private cloud. Slack also functions as the conversational interface for Agentforce, Salesforce's broader CRM-embedded AI and agent platform, with Agentforce agents able to run directly inside Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. Tableau AI, branded under the Einstein name, provides natural language querying and BI-embedded AI with CRM data integration and a Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts show no litigation on record for Salesforce at this time and no registered MCP servers in the tracked registry.
